title: Humanoid Safe Stop via Learned Stoppability Value
title_zh: 基于可停止性价值学习的人形机器人安全急停
abstract: Humanoid robots responding to emergency stop commands typically execute a fixed maneuver without reasoning about whether a safe stop is feasible from the current state. Safe-Stop casts emergency stopping as a reach-avoid problem and pairs a learned stop policy with complementary stoppability estimators: a stop-probability estimator supervised by outcomes of the fixed stop policy, and a reach-avoidance estimator supervised by a Hamilton-Jacobi backup over physical state. The stop policy and estimators are independent of the preceding behavior policy and transfer across upstream tasks. At deployment, the system commits to stopping only when both estimators indicate feasibility; otherwise it hands off to a damping fall policy.

editorial.selection_reason: 把急停建模成 reach-avoid 决策，只有经验停止概率和 Hamilton–Jacobi 可停止价值同时认可时才执行停止，在 Unitree G1 上给出强 OOD 结果。

uncertainties: fallback 是阻尼跌倒策略，不是完整安全恢复。

organization_evidence.organization: University of California, Berkeley; Carnegie Mellon University; Stanford University
